title: E2E, Migration/Authorization Coverage, and Release Hardening

requirements.requirement: Tenant Administrator sees current and closed Journeys for a Person in the selected Tenant.

evidence.testTitle: Tenant Administrator sees current and closed Journey history for one Person

requirements.requirement: Person self-service keeps current and closed Journey history and closed-Journey Work/Credit evidence readable.

evidence.testTitle: Person self-service keeps closed Journey Work and Credit Evidence durable

requirements.requirement: A Person with a non-baseline Tenant Role in one Tenant cannot receive a non-baseline Role in another Tenant until every such Role is explicitly removed, without disclosing the other Tenant or Role.

evidence.testTitle: another Tenant stays blocked until every non-baseline Role is explicitly removed without disclosure

requirements.requirement: Cross-Tenant Role isolation is scope-based and automatically covers future TENANT-scoped Roles.
Migration 000071 rejects existing conflicts and guards cross-Tenant INSERT/reactivation while explicit revocation releases the Person.
Deterministic non-Production E2E fixtures provision durable Bite 32 Journey evidence and a baseline-only cross-Tenant Role-isolation Person idempotently.

evidence.contains: expected current and closed Bite 32 Journeys
Bite 32 Role-isolation Person must start with baseline-only participation

requirements.requirement: Release migration verification requires migration 000071, both database triggers, and zero Person-level cross-Tenant TENANT-role conflicts.
LOCAL, feature CI, and deployed Playwright promotion paths all verify the Bite 32 release coverage contract before release evidence is accepted.
